title: BioIVT: therapy agent lists become a multi-select RxNorm lookup
description: Turns the four free-text agent lists on Outcome (chemotherapy, molecular targeted, immunotherapy, hormone) into a type-ahead multi-select over real RxNorm drug codes, so several agents can be picked in one question. DEMONSTRATION list: real codes, partial, not clinically reviewed; licences to be confirmed before real use.
rationale: Option C: coded medication names. One question holds several agents, as the free-text box did.
source: BioIVT Option C build for the client demonstration; approved by Dan

history.note: Phase 2 build for the client demonstration.
